lines.text: Aaron threw his staff down before Pharaoh and his officials, and it became a serpent.
Pharaoh's magicians also threw down staffs that became serpents, but Aaron's staff swallowed up the other staffs.
The LORD told Moses to wait on the bank of the Jordan and tell Pharaoh to let His people go.
Aaron struck the Nile with the staff, all the water turned to blood, and the fish died.
Pharaoh went into his palace, and the Egyptians dug around the Nile for water, and ten full days passed.
